chunks: And when Abraham said to his father and his people: 'I am free of what you worship.'
ai.seo_question: What did Abraham say to his father and people regarding their worship?
ai.summary: In the Surah Az-Zukhruf, this verse marks a pivotal moment in Prophet Abraham’s (AS) mission, where he publicly declares his *bara'ah* (disassociation) from the idolatry of his father and people, establishing the foundational Shia principle of loyalty to God and enmity toward false worshippers. This declaration underscores the transition from familial tribal ties to universal monotheism, a theme frequently cited by Shia scholars to illustrate the necessity of distinguishing between the faithful and the polytheistic masses. The narrative serves as a model for believers to maintain theological purity even when facing opposition from their own kin or society.
